rows.notes: [SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum (append to research_notes). Hunan Yuneng 2025 annual report (Y4, line 747): Spain project has its environmental approval and land levelling done (end-2025 status; no civil-works statement in the report). Construction-in-progress table shows an overseas-project line of RMB 30.64m (Y5, line 8655; budget/progress row garbled in the text: progress ~3.39%, budget ~RMB 905m - not quoted). Subsidiary Yuneng (Spain) S.L. is a wholly owned manufacturing entity registered in Spain (line 9927-9929, EUR 25.5m capital). Company-wide in-construction capacity is 70,000 t (Y1, line 879) which equals the 70kt scale of this row, but the report does not tie the 70,000 t to Spain, so it is not allocated. Capacity/start-year values unchanged (later 2026 secondary sources).

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum. Annual report (Y7, line 9880): Guangxi Yuneng is a wholly owned manufacturing subsidiary with main operating place Jingxi (广西靖西), Guangxi; Guangxi Yuning (广西裕宁, acquired 2020, goodwill line 8841-8851) is registered at the same place (line 9886), i.e. both entities are in Jingxi, probably one industrial site. Guangxi does not appear in the 2025 construction-in-progress table (Y5), so no major Guangxi project was under construction at end-2025. Plant-level capacity is NOT disclosed; company total 994,500 t (Y1) is not split. Operating status rests on the company total (no base-level production statement).

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum. Annual report (Y10, line 668): the Guizhou base integrates phosphate rock - phosphate chemicals - precursor - cathode; the company says it is fully self-supplied with iron phosphate (line 669-670), the Huangjiapo phosphate mine began shipping ore in Q4 2025 (line 740-741). Guizhou Yuneng (贵州福泉) revenue RMB 14.158bn, operating profit RMB 0.795bn (Y9, line 1644, unit 亿元, parent-company-level incl. intra-group sales possible). Guizhou has the largest construction-in-progress balance: RMB 996.96m (Y5, line 8652; project budget ~RMB 6.13bn, progress 40.6% - table garbled, not quoted). Plant capacity not disclosed - the report gives only the company total. Also note Yunnan Yuneng revenue (RMB 16.99bn) exceeds Guizhou's, so the press claim that Guizhou is the largest base is not confirmed by the filing (revenue is not capacity).

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum. The 2025 annual report records only that the board strategy committee reviewed the proposal 'to invest in Malaysia and set up a company' on 2025-07-18 (Y6, lines 2711-2715). No capacity, site or construction status in the report; the 90kt / RMB 0.95bn figures remain from the June 2026 article. The Singapore holding entities (裕能（新加坡）投资公司 EUR 65m, 裕能（新加坡）发展公司 RMB 100m, set up 2025-08-05) are listed in the subsidiary table (lines 9858, 9922-9943); whether they hold the Malaysian project is not stated. Overseas construction-in-progress line RMB 30.64m (Y5) covers overseas projects in total (Spain and/or Malaysia, not split).

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum. Annual report (Y7, lines 9883/9889): Sichuan Yuneng (registered capital RMB 350m, 100% direct) and Sichuan Yuning (RMB 210m, 100% indirect, acquired) both have main operating place Suining (四川遂宁), Sichuan - same city, probably the same industrial site, so DO NOT sum the two rows without checking. Sichuan base construction-in-progress RMB 228.31m at end-2025 (vs RMB 5.9m a year earlier; Y5, line 8654), i.e. an expansion project started in 2025. Capacity not disclosed at plant level (company total only).

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum. Annual report main-subsidiary table (Y8, lines 1640-1642): Sichuan Yuning's business scope is electronic specialty-material manufacture/R&D/sales and fertiliser sales (the scope used for iron-phosphate producers), revenue RMB 1.534bn, net profit RMB 0.248bn; located in Suining (line 9889). The filing does not say it makes LFP. Combined with the company statement that iron phosphate is fully self-supplied (Y10), Sichuan Yuning is most likely an iron-phosphate (precursor) plant feeding LFP lines - recommend the lead reclassify to step precursor / unit t FePO4 or drop from cathode sums. No capacity disclosed.

[SC104 2026-11-27] Addendum - COMPANY TOTALS (Hunan Yuneng 2025 annual report, local text 301358_2025.txt): phosphate cathode design capacity 994,500 t (sum of monthly capacities, line 879), in-construction capacity 70,000 t, capacity utilisation 113.76%, production 1,131,305.32 t, sales 1,137,084.83 t (Y1, Y2, lines 877-896).
